levels.surface: عبد الواحد بن محمد بن عبدوس النيسابوري

notes: «قال: قلت للرضا» — the asker Abd al-Salam is a link, and the Imam named after him is the last link (rule 5, owner ruling 2).
The surface keeps the preposition as written: the text joins لـ to the name (لِلرِّضَا), so no alef-lam form is copied.
The report number «4331» and «رضي الله عنه» are left out; «قد روي لنا عن آبائك» and «روي عنهم» name no one: no link.
